name: Apartbauernhof Valrunzhof
beschreibung: The Apartbauernhof Valrunzhof is situated in a tranquil and scenic rural setting in Tyrol. The spacious holiday apartments are thoughtfully appointed with a fully equipped kitchen and a cosy living area. Farm animals and lush agricultural meadows shape the authentic character of the property. Guests have the wonderful opportunity to purchase fresh regional products directly on site. In summer, the surrounding landscape invites memorable hikes, while winter offers outstanding winter sports opportunities. Warmly managed by the host family using traditional farming methods, it is an inviting retreat for families and couples alike.
